contextual_decision: Trustworthiness-related governance decisions must remain connected to relevant organisational, regulatory, and operational conditions during platform evolution
engineering_representation: Trustworthiness-related governance requirements shall remain traceable to relevant platform responsibilities and lifecycle mechanisms throughout platform evolution
anchoring_requirement: Governance requirements must remain connected to relevant lifecycle activities and responsibilities during platform evolution
scope_decision: Retain and use documented lifecycle and governance structures where they accommodate the requirement
placement_constraint: Preserve governance traceability across relevant lifecycle activities
instantiated_lifecycle_artefact: BPMN activities; governance procedures; process inputs and outputs; architectural or module-level responsibilities
evidence_link: Original TrustAIoT governance and lifecycle documentation
notes: Illustrative reconstruction; does not imply prospective CRISP-TAI execution

contextual_decision: Monitoring, feedback, maintenance, and revision capabilities must remain available during continued platform operation
engineering_representation: Monitoring, feedback, maintenance, and review mechanisms relevant to trustworthiness shall remain active, owned, and reviewable during continued platform operation and change
anchoring_requirement: Monitoring and continuity mechanisms must persist during continued operation and platform evolution
scope_decision: Retain and adapt existing monitoring, maintenance, feedback, and change-management mechanisms where required
placement_constraint: Maintain monitoring and review throughout continued operation
process_specific_activity_or_control_poi: Continuous monitoring, feedback, maintenance, and change management
instantiated_lifecycle_artefact: Monitoring mechanisms; user-feedback mechanisms; maintenance and update procedures; change-management records
evidence_link: Original TrustAIoT monitoring, feedback, maintenance, and change-management documentation
notes: Illustrative reconstruction of continuity and monitoring enactment

contextual_decision: Material regulatory, policy, operational, or stakeholder evidence may require existing contextual interpretations to be reconsidered
engineering_representation: Material regulatory, policy, operational, validation, or stakeholder evidence shall trigger review of affected contextual assumptions and, where required, revision of downstream engineering representations
anchoring_requirement: Revision mechanisms must remain connected to monitoring, governance review, and policy-adaptation processes
scope_decision: Retain or adapt documented review and policy-adaptation mechanisms according to the affected contextual condition
placement_constraint: Ensure relevant evidence can reach governance review and revision mechanisms
process_specific_activity_or_control_poi: Evidence review, change management, and policy adaptation
instantiated_lifecycle_artefact: Review records; change-management records; contextual revision or policy-adaptation records
evidence_link: Original TrustAIoT monitoring, validation, feedback, change-management, and policy-adaptation documentation
notes: CR.5 applies where evidence actually requires contextual reconsideration
